subject: WillowBend SIG intake: call timing & artifact transfer
messages:
From: Alice Connors <alice.connors@willowbend.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@willowbend.com
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake and initial artifacts - proposed times

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick responses on onboarding. We're ready to kick off the SIG/CAIQ intake for WillowBend. To make sure we get the right folks on the call, a few quick details from our side:

- Primary security contact: me (Alice Connors)
- Compliance lead: Jorge Ramirez (copied on later emails)
- We'll need a run-of-show that covers CAIQ walkthrough, logging/retention, and where to drop log samples.

Proposed times (Pacific):
- Wed May 21 — 10:00–11:00 PDT
- Thu May 22 — 09:00–10:00 PDT or 14:00–15:00 PDT

Also, can you confirm where we'd upload the initial artifacts (roles matrix + scope doc)? We can share via S3 or a Google Drive folder — whichever you prefer.

Attaching a very small starter inventory (stub): willowbend-intake-stub.txt (list of teams/contacts).

Best,
Alice
Security Manager
WillowBend Health

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SIG intake and initial artifacts - proposed times

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and the starter inventory. Wed 10:00 PDT is a little tight for our compliance engineers, but Thu May 22 at 14:00–15:00 PDT works well for the Redwood team.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Preferred transfer: secure S3 bucket (we'll create a temporary pre-signed upload link).
- Run-of-show: 1) Intro & scope 2) CAIQ walkthrough (top 10 high-risk questions) 3) Logging & sample access 4) Evidence handoff & owners 5) Q&A / next steps.

Marissa (CC) will own evidence collection on our side and will send an artifact checklist. Naomi will join to confirm log sample requirements.

I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 14:00 PDT once Marissa confirms availability.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SIG intake and initial artifacts - final logistics + invite

Alice — appreciate you uploading the two starter artifacts. Quick answers ahead of today's call:

- Raw logs: not required for the intake. Redacted or sample exports that show schema, timestamps, and retention markers are sufficient for the SIG review. If we require raw logs we'll request a narrow, time-bounded export and provide an access plan.
- S3 upload: please send the pre-signed upload link to s3-uploads@redwood.com; Marissa will confirm receipt and move files to our intake bucket.

I've sent a calendar invite (Thu May 22 14:00–15:00 PDT) with a short agenda and a Zoom link. Marissa will run the CAIQ walkthrough and Naomi will cover logs & sampling.

Next steps after call: evidence owners from WillowBend and Redwood will populate the HubSpot checklist and set an artifact delivery timeline.

See you on the call — Sean

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: sig-baseline-answers.xlsx, willowbend-roles-and-responsibilities.pdf
